scenarios.name: bbox_quantization_stress
scenarios.purpose: Synthetic validation with stronger image-feature center jitter and occasional bbox-center outliers while keeping the PX4/NED truth contract offline-only.

scenarios.name: disparity_bias_drift_stress
scenarios.purpose: Synthetic validation with stronger measured-disparity bias/noise and small focal/baseline scale drift to probe long-range range-error transfer.

scenarios.name: mixed_runtime_observation_stress
scenarios.purpose: Synthetic validation combining camera attitude error, image-feature jitter, disparity bias/noise, and mild outliers under the same RDF runtime input contract.
